# Maximizing ROI on AI Investments


Practical Applications & Success Stories from Leading Staffing Firms


Step into the future of staffing with insights from industry leaders at the World Staffing Summit 2025. In this dynamic panel,[Lauren Jones](https://www.candidately.com/speakers/lauren-jones-52a76) (Leap Advisory Partners),[Will Hayes](https://www.candidately.com/speakers/will-hayes) (IDR),[Kelly Borman](https://www.candidately.com/speakers/kelly-borman) (PRN Healthcare), and[Rob Mann](https://www.candidately.com/speakers/rob-mann) (Leap Advisory Partners) dive deep into the real-world impact of AI on staffing firms.
